_doc: T-360 Rested XP tuning — owner-editable, no code change needed. game-direction.md names rested three times as the flagship endowed-progress / appointment-to-habit lever ('rested bonus FOR logging off — WoW's genius'). A character banks a rested pool while LOGGED OUT and spends it as bonus XP on the next quest turn-ins.
_accrual_per_hour: XP-equivalent banked per hour spent logged out.
_cap_levels_multiplier: Pool ceiling = this * the current level's XP span (WoW's 150% cap).
_bonus_percent: Extra XP per boosted base point. 100 = rested doubles XP (WoW parity).
_inn_rate_multiplier_FUTURE: Inn-accelerated accrual (game-direction 'resting in a town/inn'). Deferred: logout position is not persisted server-side yet, so the server cannot know if a character logged out inside a T-092/T-187 inn volume. When position persistence lands, multiply accrual_per_hour by this while the logout point is inside an inn interior volume.
